validation_queries.description: Check that we have memory copy operations
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM memory_copies

validation_queries.description: Check for null IDs in memory copies
validation_queries.error_message: NULL entries found in id column of memory_copies
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM memory_copies WHERE id IS NULL

validation_queries.description: Check for zero or null sizes in memory copies
validation_queries.error_message: Found memory copies with zero or NULL size
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM memory_copies WHERE size IS NULL OR size = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM memory_copies WHERE dst_agent_abs_index IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM memory_copies WHERE src_agent_abs_index IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM memory_copies mc JOIN rocpd_info_agent src ON mc.src_agent_abs_index = src.absolute_index AND mc.guid = src.guid JOIN rocpd_info_agent dst ON mc.dst_agent_abs_index = dst.absolute_index AND mc.guid = dst.guid WHERE src.agent_type = 1 AND dst.agent_type = 1

validation_queries.description: Check that we have GPU agents detected
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM rocpd_info_agent WHERE type = 'GPU'
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM rocpd_info_agent WHERE name IS NULL
